text:
maya: quick idea 1 instead of multiple verbose headers, what if we add a tiny numeric surface code header `x-rw-sc` (surface-code) + keep HTTP status the canonical transport. sc is a short int that maps to badge + retry behavior.

lex: interesting. numeric codes are easy to parse and stable for dashboards. what's the proposed mapping?

maya: draft mapping: 
- 10 = quota (badge: THROTTLED)
- 20 = backpressure/capacity (badge: DEGRADED)
- 30 = downstream (badge: UNAVAILABLE)
- 90 = client-misuse (badge: OK w/ warning)
- 99 = generic failure (badge: UNAVAILABLE)
Keep `Retry-After` for time-based hints, and add optional `x-rw-rnote` (short freeform: contact-support, idempotency=no, etc.) for edge cases.

devon: i like the compactness. a couple asks: 1) document SC+status semantics clearly so SDKs don't retry blindly. 2) how do we surface idempotency?

sofia: from UX, we need deterministic one-liners per badge. examples: 
THROTTLED: "Rate limit reached 1 retry after {n}s or request quota."
DEGRADED: "Service degraded 1 responses may be slow; avoid automated retries."
UNAVAILABLE: "Service unavailable 1 try again later or contact support."
OK w/ warning: "Request accepted with warnings 1 check details."
Keep copy <=80 chars.

rui: operational notes: numeric SC helps metrics but we must record both raw `x-rw-sc` and resolved badge in traces. for non-idempotent endpoints, include `rnote=idempotency=false` so SDKs can avoid retries. also we should gate emitting `Retry-After` for non-retryable ops.

lex: infra: add a small parser that maps `x-rw-sc` -> `client_surface_bucket` tag at ingress so Prometheus/Grafana can break down charts without reprocessing logs. also add an alert rule for sudden rises in sc=20 (backpressure) vs sc=10 (quota).

telemetry-bot: new dashboard draft created: https://internal.grafana/redwood/d/errtax/error-taxonomy-overview (private).

maya: rollout plan: 1) feature-flag emit sc on internal-only tenants; 2) 7-day canary with `client_surface_bucket` telemetry tag; 3) run an S3 reclassification for last 60 days to backfill dashboards; 4) GA and SDK docs. i'll put this into an RFC and include sample SDK handling pseudocode.

devon: please add a section in RFC about SDK behavior for non-idempotent endpoints + example server pseudocode showing when to set `rnote=idempotency=false`.

ops-bot: canary scheduled 2024-12-02T08:00Z (10% traffic) for branch `err-tax/sc-header` 

maya: thanks all 1 i'll iterate RFC and ping for sign-off.
